summary:
Frontend-only verification of Vigilance module gating & redirect. All 3 role flows verified successfully.

1) NORMAL EMPLOYEE (user/pass123 - Rishi S Nayak):
   - Sidebar shows ONLY 'Dashboard' and 'Profile' (no 'Vigilance Report' link). Confirmed by evaluating all nav/aside anchors.
   - Direct navigation to /employee/vigilance -> browser lands on /employee/dashboard (redirect works).
   - No 'Operational Vigilance' heading, no vigilance table, no 'vigilance-no-access' panel present after redirect. Backend correctly returns 403 on /api/vigilance/access for this user (console shows 403).
   - /employee/attendance renders without Research Time, Break Time or Vigilance columns.

2) VIGILANCE EMPLOYEE (madhan.s/Vigil@123):
   - Login succeeds.
   - Sidebar shows 'Vigilance Report' item (highlighted when active).
   - /employee/vigilance renders 'Operational Vigilance Report' page with the full grid (Name, Date, Email, Team, Punch-In, Punch-Out, Actions, and rows). No redirect.

3) ADMIN (admin/HrAdmin@2109):
   - Login succeeds, lands on /dashboard.
   - Sidebar shows 'Vigilance Report'.
   - /vigilance renders full admin Operational Vigilance Report with data grid. No redirect.

Frontend gating & redirect are functioning per requirements.

issues: Recharts warnings: chart container has width(-1)/height(-1) - likely because Working Hours chart parent has 0 height briefly. Cosmetic console warning only.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer used without minHeight -> emits repeated console warnings on Employee Dashboard. Consider adding aspect or minHeight to suppress.
OperationalVigilance access check emits 403 in console for non-vigilance users (expected, but noisy). Consider catching 403 in the fetch to avoid red console error while still redirecting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vigilance gating verified end-to-end on frontend. Normal employee sidebar contains only Dashboard + Profile (module_visibility API is filtering correctly). Direct URL /employee/vigilance redirects via <Navigate replace/> in OperationalVigilance.js when GET /api/vigilance/access returns 403. Vigilance employee (madhan.s) and admin both see the report. Attendance for normal employee has no Research/Break/Vigilance columns.
